label: CSS
pipeline: CSS → native ZigCSS core → compact CSS
note: The native CSS path parses, emits, and independently validates the authored stylesheet.

label: SCSS
pipeline: SCSS → native Sass frontend → ZigCSS core → compact CSS
note: The native SCSS path is checked against the development-only Dart Sass 1.101.0 oracle before strict generated-CSS validation.

label: Sass
pipeline: Indented Sass → native Sass frontend → ZigCSS core → compact CSS
note: The native indented-Sass path preserves authored source bytes and is checked against the development-only Dart Sass 1.101.0 oracle.

label: Less
pipeline: Less → native Less frontend → ZigCSS core → compact CSS
note: The native Less path retains its frozen 4.6.7 conformance baseline while exact Less 4.9.0 serves as the development-only forward oracle; invalid generated CSS is rejected before output.

label: Stylus
pipeline: Stylus → native Stylus frontend → ZigCSS core → compact CSS
note: The native Stylus path is checked against the development-only Stylus 0.64.0 oracle; plugins and evaluator hooks remain outside the product contract.
